items.brief: Tokenized commodities expand beyond gold into lending and oil

items.brief: Visa survey: nearly half of APAC consumers open to stablecoins by 2031

items.brief: Pollak: equities, non-dollar stablecoins to lead tokenization supercycle

items.brief: XRP Ledger adds controls for banks, stablecoins, tokenized funds
items.why: Enables banks to manage tokenized assets with limited account permissions.
